description: Header file defining wrapper classes for sensor subHAL interfaces supporting multiple versions (V2.0 and V2.1) in Android hardware sensors. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and version-specific implementations.

classes.name: ISubHalWrapperBase
classes.description: Abstract base class defining interface for sensor subHAL wrappers supporting different versions.

classes.name: SubHalWrapperBase
classes.description: Template class implementing common functionality for subHAL wrappers, parameterized by subHAL type.

classes.name: SubHalWrapperV2_0
classes.description: Wrapper class for V2.0 sensor subHAL implementation.

classes.name: SubHalWrapperV2_1
classes.description: Wrapper class for V2.1 sensor subHAL implementation, supporting new event features.

methods.name: supportsNewEvents
methods.description: Indicates if the wrapper supports new sensor event features (V2.1).

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the subHAL with callback, wakelock ref, and index.

methods.name: getSensorsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of sensors supported by the subHAL.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the operation mode of the sensor subHAL.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor handle.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures sensor sampling period and report latency.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor data for a given handle.

methods.name: injectSensorData
methods.description: Injects sensor event data into the subHAL.

methods.name: registerDirectChannel
methods.description: Registers a direct memory channel for sensor data.

methods.name: configDirectReport
methods.description: Configures direct report rate for a sensor.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information to a file descriptor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subHAL.
